item.title: Ayodhya turns into fortress ahead of PM Modi’s flag-hoisting at Ram Temple; Full details here | Dynamite News
item.description: Ayodhya has been turned into a high-security zone ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit for the ceremonial flag-hoisting atop the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Temple. Nearly 7,000 security personnel, anti-drone systems, snipers and specialised units have been deployed.

item.title: North India shivers as Kashmir dips to –5°C; Relentless rains lash South India | Dynamite News
item.description: North India is witnessing an intense drop in temperatures as winter tightens its grip. Kashmir has plunged to sub-zero conditions, with several locations recording temperatures as low as –5°C. Punjab, Haryana and parts of Bengal are also experiencing a sharp fall in mercury levels.

item.title: Delhi chokes as AQI stays above 400; Will Ethiopia’s Volcano Ash worsen the air? | Dynamite News
item.description: Delhi’s air quality has plunged into the ‘very poor’ category, with 37 out of 39 monitoring stations recording AQI above 300 and several crossing the 400 mark. Rohini reported the worst AQI at 416. Surrounding NCR cities including Noida, Ghaziabad and Gurugram are also in the red zone.

item.title: Ethiopia Volcano ash reaches India; Flights cancelled, DGCA issues advisory | Dynamite News
item.description: A massive volcanic ash cloud from Ethiopia’s Heliy Gubi volcano, which erupted after 12,000 years, is now reaching India, affecting flight operations and prompting safety advisories. Several international and domestic flights have been canceled or rerouted, particularly over Delhi, Haryana, and western Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: “…another valiant Giant has left us”, Amitabh Bachchan emotional as Dharmendra leaves silence behind | Dynamite News
item.description: Bollywood legend Dharmendra passed away on 24 November at the age of 89, leaving the film industry in shock. Stars from Bollywood and South India paid tribute to the veteran actor. Amitabh Bachchan, in an emotional post, remembered Dharmendra as a flawless personality and a symbol of simplicity, charm, and generosity.

item.title: Gold hits fresh high, Silver follows as markets rally; Check rates here | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices surged past ₹1.25 lakh in India, while silver crossed ₹1.56 lakh, as US Federal Reserve hints at a possible rate cut next month. The gains in international markets reflected in India’s MCX trading, with investors optimistic about further price hikes.

item.title: Chinese man arrested at UP-Nepal border entering illegally into India | Dynamite News
item.description: SSB commandant Ganga Singh Udavat, while talking to media persons said that Qunjing was caught while filming sensitive areas while crossing the border. Udavat further said that Qunjing had crossed into India from Nepal.

item.title: Ayodhya: PM Modi, Mohan Bhagwat hoist sacred flag at Ram Temple; Full details | Dynamite News
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, along with RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat, hoisted the Sacred Flag atop the Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir in Ayodhya in a historic ceremony. Arriving via Maharshi Valmiki Airport and proceeding in a road-show style from Saket Mahavidyalaya to the Sapt Mandir, PM Modi led the ritual amid Vedic chants.
